observed.caption: Colorful buses travel on a multi-lane road under a large archway toward twin cylindrical towers under an overcast sky.
observed.description: A wide paved multi-lane road stretches from the foreground into the distance with several buses and vehicles moving along it, including a prominent red and gray bus in the left foreground, a blue bus and a second red bus further down the road, and a silver van and a motorcycle on the right. A large arch with a striped pattern and a shield emblem on top spans the road in the middle distance. Behind the arch and to the left, a tall building with two striped cylindrical towers and a red lattice mast rises above lower commercial buildings with blue awnings and shop fronts. A tall leaning palm tree stands on the left sidewalk, dense green trees line the right side of the road, and a large yellow billboard is mounted on the lower portion of the tower building. The sky is overcast and gray with diffuse daylight.
